# `aitbc bounty status`

Show the on-chain lock/payout/refund transfers recorded for a bounty.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bounty status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--bounty-id` | text | — | yes | Bounty identifier to look up on-chain |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query (defaults to the node's) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (overrides config) |
| `--limit` | integer | `200` | no | Max transactions scanned per type |
| `--json` | flag | `false` | no | Emit the result as JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bounty status --bounty-id <bounty_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc bounty status --bounty-id <bounty_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
